messages:
incident-bot: Pager: High error rate detected on /v1/generate (us-west-2). 5xx spike >15% over 5m, latency SLO violated. PagerDuty: SRE-oncall.

alice: seeing it, acked. jumping in as oncall. :bell:

raj: any recent deploys? can we rule that out before chasing infra?

alice: checking deploys now.

deploy-bot: No successful deploys to production in the last 30m. Last deploy: rl-update-2026-03-15 (12:11 UTC) -> config push to rate-limiter.

alice: logs show a tight burst throttle at the gateway then downstream 502/504s as workers exhausted. looks like 429 upstream -> cascading 5xx. snippet:
```
[12:34:21] gateway: req_id=abc123 status=429 limit=100 burst=20
[12:34:22] frontend: req_id=abc123 upstream=timeout error=504
[12:34:23] worker: pool=generate max_threads=64 exhausted
```

emma: customer impact? which tenants seeing errors?

alice: initial query: ~25% of requests for v1/generate in us-west-2 experiencing 429/5xx. high-traffic tenants A and B most affected. sending list to CS.

raj: I think rl-update-2026-03-15 accidentally promoted a global quota policy that applies to the entire gateway rather than per-tenant. that would explain shared burst exhaustion and the downstream timeouts.

alice: agreed. mitigation options: 1) revert rate-limit config, 2) temporarily increase global burst/limit, 3) route heavy tenants to dedicated pool. recommend quick bump + revert after stabilization.

mitch: +1 for quick bump to stop customer impact, but we need to avoid oscillation. keep a short window for revert.

alice: executing emergency change: `infra-cli rate-limiter update --policy global --burst 2000 --rate 2000/s --reason "emergency mitigation for cascade"`

infra-bot: rate-limiter config updated (rl-global). rolling restart of gateway pods initiated.

alice: confirming metrics - error rate dropping. 5xx went from 18% -> 3% in ~4m after change. latency trending down. will keep watch for 15m. :white_check_mark:

lucy: CS note: informed tenant A & B support teams about mitigation, offered correlation logs, ETA for full resolution ~30-60m.

raj: quick post-check: we still see elevated concurrency on worker pools. recommend temporarily enabling request queueing and backpressure so worker pool doesn't fully exhaust while we revert config in CI.

alice: enabling queued mode on generate service: `kubectl -n prod patch deploy generate-service -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"service/queue-mode":"enabled"}}}}}'`

infra-bot: generate-service scaled rolling restart with queue-mode annotation applied.

alice: monitoring: no new 502s after queue enabled. overall success rate recovering.

mitch: good. action items: 1) rollback the misapplied promotion in rl-update-2026-03-15, 2) add CI gate to prevent global promotion without approval, 3) add synthetic test that exercises per-tenant burst behavior, 4) incident postmortem. assign owners.

alice: created ticket TCK-3421 for rollback + CI gate, owner @raj, ETA EOD. created TCK-3422 for synthetic tests, owner @emma. will draft incident postmortem once we stabilize.

emma: I'll draft customer-facing summary and coordinate with Lucy.

alice: final status for now: mitigation applied (rate bump + queue-mode) and error rate returned to acceptable SLOs. monitoring for 30m before closing pager. will update thread with timeline and root cause once rollback confirmed.

incident-bot: Pager status: acknowledged -> mitigated.
